arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مُنْتَهَى مَطْلَبِ الْحَاجَاتِ
transliteration: allāhumma yā muntaḥā maṭlab al-ḥājāt
english_text: O God, O ultimate object of needs!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ عِنْدَه نَيْلُ الطَّلِبَاتِ
transliteration: wa yā man ʿindahu naylu al-ṭalibāt
english_text: O He through whom requests are attained!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لا يَبِيْعُ نِعَمَهُ بالأثْمَانِ
transliteration: wayā man lā yabīʿu niʿamahu bil-ʾathmān
english_text: O He whose favours are not bought by prices!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُكَدِّرُ عَطَايَاهُ بِالامْتِنَانِ
transliteration: wa yā man lā yukaddiru ʿatāyāhū bil-ʾamtinān
english_text: O He who does not muddy His gifts by the imposition of obligations!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يُسْتَغْنَى بِهِ وَلاَ يُسْتَغْنَى عَنْهُ
transliteration: wa yā man yustaghna bihī walā yustaghna ʿanhu
english_text: O He along with whom nothing is needed and without whom nothing can be done!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يُرْغَبُ إلَيْهِ وَلا يُرْغَبُ عَنْهُ.
transliteration: wa yā man yurghabu ilayhi wa lā yurghabu ʿanhu
english_text: O He toward whom desire is ever directed and never turned away!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لا تُفنى خَزَآئِنَهُ الْمَسَائِلُ
transliteration: wa yā man lā tufnā khazāʾinahu al-masāʾilu
english_text: O He whose treasuries cannot be exhausted by demands!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تُبَدِّلُ حِكْمَتَهُ الْوَسَائِلُ.
transliteration: wa yā man lā tubaddilu ḥikmatahu al-wasāʾilu
english_text: O He whose wisdom cannot be altered by any means!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهُ حَوَائِجُ الْمُحْتَاجِينَ
transliteration: wa yā man lā tanqaṭiʿu ʿanhu ḥawāʾiju al-muḥtājīn
english_text: O He from whom the needs of the needy are never cut off!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُعَنِّيهِ دُعَاءُ الدَّاعِينَ
transliteration: wa yā man lā yu'annīhi du'ā'u al-dā'īn
english_text: O He who is not distressed by the supplications of the supplicators!

arabic_text: تَمَدَّحْتَ بِالْغَنَاءِ عَنْ خَلْقِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْغِنَى عَنْهُمْ وَنَسَبْتَهُمْ إلَى الفَقْرِ وَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْفَقْرِ إلَيْكَ.
transliteration: tamaddaḥta bil-ghinā'i ʿan khalqika wa anta ahlul-ghinā'i ʿanhum wa nasabtahum 'ila al-faqri wa hum 'ahl al-faqri 'ilayka
english_text: Thou hast lauded Thyself for having no need for Thy creatures, and it suits Thee to have no need for them, and Thou hast attributed to them poverty, and it suits them to be poor toward Thee.

arabic_text: فَمَنْ حَاوَلَ سَدَّ خَلَّتِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَرَامَ صَرْفَ الْفَقْر عَنْ نَفْسِهِ بِكَ فَقَدْ طَلَبَ حَاجَتَهُ فِي مَظَانِّها وَأَتَى طَلِبَتَهُ مِنْ وَجْهِهَا
transliteration: faman ḥāwala sadda khallatihi min ʿindika wa rāma ṣarfa al-faqr ʿan nafsihi bika faqad ṭalaba ḥājatahu fī maẓānnihā wa'atā ṭalibatahu min wajhihā
english_text: So he who strives to remedy his lack through what is with Thee and wishes to turn poverty away from himself through Thee has sought his need in the most likely place and come to his request from the right quarter.

arabic_text: وَمَنْ تَوَجَّهَ بِحَاجَتِهِ إلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَوْ جَعَلَهُ سَبَبَ نُجْحِهَا دُونَكَ فَقَدْ تَعَرَّضَ لِلْحِرْمَانِ وَاسْتَحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَوْتَ الاِحْسَانِ
transliteration: wa man tawajjah bihaajatihi ila ahad min khalkika aw jaʿalahu sababan nujhihaa dūnaka faqad taʿarraḍa lilḥirman wa-istaḥaqqā min ʿindika fawt al-iḥsān
english_text: But he who turns in his need toward one of Thy creatures or assigns the cause of its being granted to other than Thee, has exposed himself to deprivation and deserves to miss Thy beneficence.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَلِي إلَيْكَ حَاجَةٌ قَـدْ قَصَّرَ عَنْهَـا جُهْدِي وَتَقَطَّعَتْ دُونَهَا حِيَلِي
transliteration: allāhumma wali ilayka ḥājaẗun qad qaṣṣara ʿanhā juhdi wa taqattaʿat doonaha hiyalii
english_text: O God, I have a need of Thee: my exertion has fallen short of it and my stratagems have been cut back before reaching it.

arabic_text: وَسَوَّلَتْ لِيْ نَفْسِي رَفْعَهَا إلَى مَنْ يَرْفَعُ حَوَائِجَهُ إلَيْكَ وَلاَ يَسْتَغْنِي فِي طَلِبَاتِهِ عَنْكَ وَهِيَ زَلَّةٌ مِنْ زَلَلِ الْخَاطِئِينَ وَعَثْرَةٌ مِنْ عَثَراتِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ
transliteration: wa sawwalat li nafsi raf'aha ila man yarf'u hawa'ijahu ilayk wa lā yastaġnī fī ṭalibātihī ʿanka wa hiya zallatun min zallil-khāṭi'īn waʿathratun min ʿatharatil-mudhnibin
english_text: My soul induced me to present it to him who presents his needs to Thee and can do nothing without Thee in his requests, but this is one the slips of the offenders, one of the stumbles of the sinners!

arabic_text: ثُمَّ انْتَبَهْتُ بِتَذْكِيرِكَ لِي مِنْ غَفْلَتِي وَنَهَضْتُ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ مِنْ زَلَّتِي وَ رَجَعتُ وَنَكَصْتُ بِتَسْـدِيدِكَ عَنْ عَثْـرَتِي
transliteration: thumma 'intabahtu bitadhkirika li min ghaflati wa nahadtu bi-tawfiqika min zallati wa rajaʿtu wanakastu bitasdīdika ʿan ʿathrati
english_text: Then through Thy reminding me, I was aroused from my heedlessness, through Thy giving success, I stood up from my slip, and through Thy pointing the way, I returned and withdrew from my stumble.

arabic_text: وَقُلْتُ: سُبْحَانَ رَبّي كَيْفَ يَسْأَلُ مُحْتَاجٌ مُحْتَاجـاً
transliteration: wa qultu: subḥāna rabbī kayfa yas'al muḥtājun muḥtājan
english_text: I said: Glory be to my Lord! How can the needy ask from the needy?

arabic_text: وَأَنَّى يَرْغَبُ مُعْدِمٌ إلَى مُعْدِم؟
transliteration: waʾannā yarġabu muʿdimun ilā muʿdim?
english_text: How can the destitute beseech the destitute?

arabic_text: فَقَصَدْتُكَ يا إلهِي بِالرَّغْبَةِ وَأَوْفَدْتُ عَلَيْكَ رَجَائِي بِالثِّقَةِ بِكَ
transliteration: faqaṣadtu-ka yā ilāhī bil-raġbah wa awfadtu ʿalayka rajāʾī bit-thiqati bika
english_text: So I went straight to Thee, my God, in beseeching, and I sent Thee my hope with trust in Thee.

arabic_text: وَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّ كَثِيرَ مَا أَسْأَلُكَ يَسِيرٌ فِي وُجْدِكَ وَأَنَّ خَطِيرَ مَا أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ حَقِيرٌ فِيْ وُسْعِكَ
transliteration: wa ʿalimtu anna kathira maa as’aluka yaseerun fi wujdika wa anna khaṭīra ma astawhibuka haqīrun fi wusʿika
english_text: I came to know that the many I request from Thee are few before Thy wealth, the weighty I ask from Thee is vile before Thy plenty;

arabic_text: وَأَنَّ كَرَمَكَ لاَ يَضِيقُ عَنْ سُؤَال أحَد وَأَنَّ يَدَكَ بِالْعَطايا أَعْلَى مِنْ كُلِّ يَد.
transliteration: waanna karamaka la yadīqu ʿan suʾāli aḥad wa-anna yadaka bil-'ataya a'la min kulli yad
english_text: Thy generosity is not constrained by anyone's asking, Thy hand is higher in bestowing gifts than every hand!

arabic_text: أللَهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاحْمِلْنِي بِكَرَمِكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ وَلاَ تَحْمِلْنِي بِعَدْلِكَ عَلَى الاسْتِحْقَاقِ
transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa aḥmilnī bika ramika ʿalā at-tafaḍḍ walā tahmilnī biʿadlika ʿalā al-istiḥqāq
english_text: O God, so bless Muhammad and His Household, take me through They generosity to Thy gratuitous bounty And take me not through Thy justice to what I deserve!

arabic_text: فَما أَنَا بِأَوَّلِ رَاغِبِ رَغِبَ إلَيْكَ فَأَعْطَيْتَهُ وَهُوَ يَسْتَحِقُّ الْمَنْعَ وَلاَ بِأَوَّلِ سَائِل سَأَلَكَ فَأَفْضَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَسْتَوْجِبُ الْحِرْمَانَ.
transliteration: famā anā bi-awwali rāghibi raghiba ilayka fa-aʿṭaytahu wa huwa yastahiqq al-manaʿa walā bi-ʾawwali sāʾil saʾalaka faʾafdaltahu wa-huwā yastawjibu al-ḥirmān
english_text: I am not the first beseecher to beseech Thee and Thou bestowed upon him while he deserved withholding, nor am I the first to ask from Thee and Thou wast bounteous toward him while he merited deprivation.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَكُنْ لِدُعَائِي مُجِيباً وَمِنْ نِدائِي قَرِيباً وَلِتَضَرُّعِي رَاحِماً وَلِصَوْتِي سَامِعاً وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ رَجَائِي عَنْكَ وَلا تَبُتَّ سَبَبِي مِنْكَ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa kun li duʿāʾi mujīban wa min nidāʾi qarīban wa li-taḍarruʿī rāḥimān wa li-ṣawtī sāmiʿan walā taqṭaʿ rajāʾī ʿanka wa-lā tabutta sababī minka
english_text: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household, respond to my supplication, come near my call, have mercy on my pleading, listen to my voice, cut not short my hope for Thee, sever not my thread to Thee,

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُوَجِّهْنِي فِي حَاجَتيْ هَذِهِ وَغَيْرِهَا إلى سِوَاكَ وَتَوَلَّنِي بِنُجْحِ طَلِبَتِي وَقَضاءِ حَاجَتِي وَنَيْلِ سُؤْلِي قَبْلَ زَوَالِي عَنْ مَوْقِفِي هَذَا بِتَيسِيرِكَ لِيَ الْعَسِيْرَ وَحُسْنِ تَقْدِيرِكَ لِي فِي جَمِيعِ الأُمُورِ.
transliteration: wa lā tuwajjihnī fī ḥājati hādhīhi wa ghayrihā ilā siwāka wa tawallanī binujḥi ṭalibatī wa qaḍā'ī ḥājatī wa nāyli su'li qabli zawāli 'an mawqifi hadhā bi tayseerika liyal-ʿasira wa husni taqdeerika li fi jameeʿil-umoori
english_text: turn not my face in this my need, and other needs, away from Thee, attend for my sake to the fulfillment of my request, the granting of my need, and the attainment of what I have asked before I leave this place through Thy making easy for me the difficult and Thy excellent ordainment for me in all affairs!

arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ صَلاَةً دَائِمَةً نَامِيَةً لاَ انْقِطَاعَ لأِبَدِهَا وَلا مُنْتَهَى لأِمَدِهَا وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ عَوْناً لِيْ وَسَبَباً لِنَجَاحِ طَلِبَتِي إنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيْمٌ.
transliteration: wa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī ṣalātan dāʾimatan nāmiyatān lā inqiṭāʿa wala muntaḥā li-amadihā wa'aj'al dhālika ʿawna liyy wa-sababan li-najāḥi ṭalabatī innaka w
english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household with a permanent, ever-growing blessing, whose perpetuity has no cutting off and whose term knows no limit, and make that a help to me and a cause for the granting of my request! Thou art Boundless, Generous!

arabic_text: وَمِنْ حَاجَتِي يَا رَبِّ كَذَا وَكَذَا وَتَذْكُرُ حَاجَتَكَ ثمّ تَسْجُـدُ وَتَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِكَ: فَضْلُكَ آنَسَنِي وَإحْسَانُكَ دَلَّنِي فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَبِمُحَمَّـد وَآلِهِ صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهمْ أَنْ لاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً.
transliteration: wa min ḥājatī yā rabbī kadha wa kadha wa tadhkur haajataka thumma tasjudu wa taqulu fi sujoodika: faḍluka ʾānasani wa iḥsānuka dallanī fa-as'aluka bika wa bi-muhammadin wa ālihi ṣalātuka ʿalayhim an lā taruddanī khāʾiban
english_text: And of my needs,my Lord, are such and such (Here you should state your needs, then prostrate yourself, and say in your prostration:) Thy bounty has comforted me and Thy beneficence has shown the way, So I ask Thee by Thee and by Muhammad and his Household (Thy blessings be upon them) that Thou sendest me not back in disappointment!
